verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing platform, and buyers can reasonably ask whether such infrastructure can be deployed on their own servers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Pomelo; the docs describe only hosted APIs, a Dashboard and an MCP server. The option to authorize transactions with your own authorizer instead of Pomelo's Core is an adjacent capability, not self-hosting the product, so it earns no credit.
